generators.carrier: finite nonempty memory carrier M, finite input alphabet I, total deterministic
equivalence relations on M; one step of partition refinement using report and update

relations.statement: A relation E on M is a report-respecting update congruence if m E m' implies r(m) ≈ r(m') and u(m,i) E u(m',i) for all i in I
relations.hypotheses: ≈ is a validated report equivalence on O (or equality for exact readout); u total and deterministic

relations.statement: G_refine is monotone and deflationary on the lattice of equivalence relations; its greatest fixed point is the greatest report-respecting update congruence
relations.hypotheses: M finite nonempty; the start relation is the report-kernel of ≈

lemmas.statement: Descending refinement from the report kernel stabilises in at most |M|-1 strict steps on a finite nonempty M, and the stable relation is the greatest report-respecting update congruence
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem refine_terminates {M I O : Type} [Fintype M] [Nonempty M] (u : M → I → M) (r : M → O) : True := by sorry

lemmas.statement: The quotient by the greatest congruence is the minimal report-respecting quotient, and behavioural classes coincide with its classes

near_misses.claim: A tolerant, non-transitive comparison yields a well-defined quotient
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Quotient and refinement need ≈ to be an equivalence; tolerance breaks transitivity (CM4)

near_misses.claim: Update alone determines retention without a report
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Without a readout the greatest congruence is trivial, so nothing is observable (CM2)
